These rocks can be obtained the following ways:
• Completing dungeons in Daemonheim. 
• Completing Sinkholes.
• Killing monsters in any of the Elite Dungeons (regular or story mode). 
Rocks are awarded at the end of Daemonheim floors and sinkholes.
The most effective way to obtain the rocks is by killing Laboratory Slimes in the first area of the Dragonkin Laboratory in Story Mode. Note that the chance of receiving the second rock if attempting to receive it immediately after the first rock is significantly diminished. If the player happens to receive a golden rock in another skill before receiving the second rock, this chance is reset.
